title: Curate Annotations with Preview, Apply and Undo (Offline)

graphics.caption: The native Feature Editor previews the exact 21..40 to 21..45 boundary change, keeps Apply tied to the current request and lists related annotations without modifying them.
The Create preview retains ordered label/gene qualifiers and identifies the overlapping gene and segment_A records as review-only candidates, explicitly not modifications.

catalog.notes: Synthetic Feature Editor exercise covering Location, Create, Split, Merge and Delete, review-only overlaps/shared identifiers, stale previews and unchanged DNA. Native Location/Create previews are retained; CLI regressions do not substitute for complete live GUI apply/undo/redo acceptance.
